args.title: Cold-chain logistics 2026 — combined summary
args.body:
Sources: https://blog.ironbark.example/2026/cold-chain and companion piece https://insights.ironbark.example/cold-chain/companion

- In 2026, temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data.
- Most savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from reduced spoilage.
- Companion piece: cold-chain pilots cut claims by a quarter (~25%).
